title: About & Contact — Saving Vista School
meta_description: About Saving Vista School and how to get in touch.
subhead: Have a question, or need to reach the school office? Get in touch below.
section_about_body: Vista School is a free, public charter school in Ivins, Utah, serving students in grades K–9 with an emphasis on Arts, Technology, and STEM academics (source: vistautah.com). This background is provided for context only — Saving Vista School is not affiliated with or speaking on behalf of Vista School.
section_mission_body: Saving Vista School is a nonprofit organized by a group of concerned parents. We believe a number of recent decisions by the school's administration deserve closer scrutiny, and we are engaging directly with Vista's Charter Board and the Utah State Charter School Board to push for transparency and accountability.
form_note_privacy: Messages sent through this form go to our nonprofit inbox (savingvistaschool@gmail.com). We'll do our best to respond promptly.
alt_body: However you found your way here, there's a way to help — share what you know, or just reach out with a question.
